title: Model Usage
text: raw ENMs retrieved using method can used regular e1071 SVM model objects. Alternatively, helper function elements::predict_occ_taxon retrieves model using method , generates predictions, formats results data frame. additional helper function elements::predict_occ can generate predictions multiple taxa, either specifing taxa model ‘taxa’ argument, setting ‘taxa’ NULL including additional column predictors data frame named ‘taxon_code’. Two helper arguments provide additional functionality controlling model use. First, ‘limit’ argument, assigns probability values zero one predictors outside specified range e.g. 10% 90% quantiles (see elements::NicheWidths). Second, ‘holdopt’ argument, holds specified variable values optima (defined mean value present elements::NicheWidths). simple demonstration, two sets predictions Stellaria graminea generated, holding variables apart N optima: 1) limit set, 2) limit set 1% 99% quantiles.  Please note ten eleven variables held optima predicted probabilities high influence unsuitable N values partially offset. Consequently, shape response curves wider corresponding PDP plot produced elements::plot_me function (see Model Inspection).

title: Model Usage
text: elements can also used filter species pools based given set predictor values using function elements::env_filter. Two sets methods available: 1) “svm” generates predictions using elements::predict_occ uses resultant probability values; 2) “mean” “median” calculates normalised euclidean distance values supplied ‘predictors’ argument mean median niche positions present elements::NicheWidths. NOTE: mean median methods included demonstrative purposes used practice consider joint distribution variables expressed SVM model hypervolumes. option apply elements::envelope_filter function, first screens supplied taxa check whether predictor values within given range supplied ‘limit’ argument (“min_max”, “q01_q99”, “q05_q95”, “q10_q90”, “q25_q75”), controlled ‘screen’ argument; elements::env_filter run computationally expensive elements::predict_occ elements::calc_distance functions taxa within limits. highly recommended usually results 95% reduction number taxa supplied elements::predict_occ elements::calc_distance, greatly improving performance. example, elements::env_filter applied taxa elements::ModelledTaxaCodes using svm method, predictors derived elements::ExampleScenarios. practice, given limited size regional species pools /interest particular group taxa often practical supply reduced list taxa elements::env_filter.
